title: The merge tool reads a recorded owner ruling and lifts one negative-net-value hold

The coordinator started lane owner-accepts-held-negative (session_013NEJL12kgUeBo4mh4sjvci; triage get_session read: running, connected, parent the coordinator, tag cs-step:owner-accepts-held-negative): it makes the tool read a recorded owner ruling (own-3381-a) and lift that one hold. The coordinator refused the alternative, a false net value in the record. Coordinator's pick, undoable, not the owner's. The ruling's only home is origin/roadmap at roadmap/rulings/own-3381-a.json (triage confirmed by git show origin/roadmap at 01:54 CST), not main: the tool would read a file off main, the same gap as ruling own-archive-off-page (decision waiting-data-in-repo cites it; step status-page-size-cap). The lane reads the ruling there. PR 3381 waits on this lane (step start-session-not-pretooluse); lane start-checks-after-call waits on the 3381 merge. The grant covers only the act the ruling names (merging 3381 as is); the lane must not make the tool lift any other hold.
